summary: Stratasys Ltd., a dual-listed Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026 attaching its notice and proxy statement for the 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, plus a form of proxy card. The meeting is set for 3:00 p.m. Israel time on November 10, 2026, at Meitar Law Offices, Givatayim, Israel, with a record date of October 9, 2026. Shareholders will vote on re-electing seven incumbent directors plus the initial election of David Chinn, re-appointing Kesselman Kesselman (PricewaterhouseCoopers) as independent auditors, and authorizing the board to set auditor remuneration. Audited 2025 financials will also be presented. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
